**ReportingService directly depends on BillingService and OrderService.** Its full dependency tree, down to the databases, is:

```text
ReportingService
├── DEPENDS_ON → BillingService
│   ├── STORES → BillingPostgresDatabase
│   ├── CALLS → NotificationsAPI
│   └── DEPENDS_ON → OrderService
│       ├── STORES → OrdersPostgresDatabase
│       ├── CALLS → PaymentsAPI
│       └── DEPENDS_ON → UserService
│           └── STORES → UsersPostgresDatabase
└── DEPENDS_ON → OrderService
    ├── STORES → OrdersPostgresDatabase
    ├── CALLS → PaymentsAPI
    └── DEPENDS_ON → UserService
        └── STORES → UsersPostgresDatabase
```

Across those paths, ReportingService depends on **three services**, **two APIs**, and **three databases**:

| Type | Dependencies |
|---|---|
| Services | BillingService, OrderService, UserService |
| APIs | NotificationsAPI, PaymentsAPI |
| Databases | BillingPostgresDatabase, OrdersPostgresDatabase, UsersPostgresDatabase |

No configuration keys were returned by the dependency traversal.
